items.q: Apakah yang boleh dibuka oleh BiblioFuse Reader?
items.a: BiblioFuse Reader mengendalikan komik, manga, PDF, EPUB dan TXT dalam satu perpustakaan — termasuk koleksi campuran besar yang anda strim dari Mac atau PC sendiri. Semuanya diproses pada peranti anda: tiada muat naik, tiada akaun dan tiada penjejakan bacaan.

items.q: Adakah fail saya dimuat naik ke pelayan BiblioFuse?
items.a: Tidak. Aplikasi dibina sekitar pemprosesan pada peranti. Pembacaan, mampatan, imbasan pendua, dan alat web memproses fail secara setempat. Penyegerakan dan strim menggunakan iCloud, rangkaian tempatan, atau Tailscale anda sendiri, bukan akaun BiblioFuse.

Kebanyakan aplikasi BiblioFuse boleh dicuba percuma atau mempunyai had percuma, dengan naik taraf berbayar pilihan untuk penggunaan lebih berat. Halaman kedai menunjukkan harga semasa bagi setiap platform.

seo.desc: SmartDecrypt auto-unlocks PDF, ZIP, and 7z files using saved filename patterns — perfect for bank statements, insurance docs, and invoices that always use the same password format. Drop the file, it finds the right password automatically.

hero.title: Lepas fail. Ia membuka sendiri.
hero.desc: SmartDecrypt memadankan fail anda dengan profil kata laluan tersimpan mengikut corak nama fail — jadi membuka penyata bank atau invois tidak perlu mencari kata laluan yang tepat lagi.

patterns.title: Simpan sekali, buka selamanya
patterns.desc: Penyata bank, PDF insurans, dan slip gaji sentiasa tiba dengan corak kata laluan yang sama — NRIC anda, tarikh lahir, atau nombor akaun. Simpan profil sekali dan SmartDecrypt memilih kata laluan yang tepat secara automatik setiap kali jenis fail itu tiba.
patterns.bullet1: Padankan mengikut corak nama fail — cth. "DBS_Statement_*" → kata laluan NRIC anda
patterns.bullet2: Profil berasingan untuk penyata bank, PDF insurans, invois, slip gaji
patterns.bullet3: Kitaran kata laluan automatik — cuba semua profil yang sepadan secara berturutan

formats.title: PDF, ZIP, dan 7z — ketiga-tiganya

formats.bullet1: PDF — buka dan simpan dokumen lengkap utuh
formats.bullet2: ZIP & 7z — ekstrak kandungan dengan atau tanpa kata laluan
formats.bullet3: Arkib yang tidak disulitkan diekstrak secara automatik — tidak perlu digesa

mobile.title: Terima fail dari mana-mana. Kata laluan tetap peribadi.
mobile.desc: Pada iPhone dan iPad, buka fail terus dalam SmartDecrypt atau hantarkan melalui iOS Share Sheet daripada Files, Mail, atau aplikasi lain. Kata laluan disimpan secara eksklusif dalam Keychain sistem — tidak pernah dalam pangkalan data, tidak pernah di pelayan.
mobile.bullet1: iOS Share Sheet — hantar fail daripada Files, Mail, Safari, dan lainnya
mobile.bullet2: Kata laluan disimpan dalam Apple Keychain, bukan dalam aplikasi
mobile.bullet3: Fail diproses secara lokal — tiada yang dimuat naik

faq.q: Apakah format fail yang disokong SmartDecrypt?
faq.a: PDF, ZIP, dan 7z. Arkib ZIP dan 7z yang tidak disulitkan diekstrak secara normal tanpa meminta kata laluan. SmartDecrypt tidak menyokong RAR, EPUB, atau format lain pada masa ini.

faq.q: Adakah SmartDecrypt memintas kata laluan yang tidak diketahui?
faq.a: Tidak. SmartDecrypt direka untuk fail yang anda sudah mempunyai kebenaran untuk mengakses. Ia menggunakan kata laluan yang anda simpan dalam profil — ia tidak memecah atau brute-force kata laluan yang tidak diketahui.

faq.q: Adakah kata laluan saya selamat?
faq.a: Ya. Kata laluan disimpan secara eksklusif dalam Keychain sistem pada peranti anda — penyimpanan selamat yang sama yang digunakan oleh Safari dan aplikasi lain anda. SmartDecrypt tidak pernah menyimpan kata laluan dalam pangkalan datanya sendiri, dan tiada yang dimuat naik ke mana-mana pelayan.

faq.q: Apakah itu corak nama fail?
faq.a: Corak nama fail ialah nama separa atau kata kunci yang mengenal pasti fail berulang. Contohnya, jika bank anda menghantar penyata bulanan bernama 'BankStatement_2024-01.pdf', buat profil dengan corak 'BankStatement' dan kata laluan. SmartDecrypt memadankan fail masa depan dengan profil itu secara automatik.

faq.q: Adakah pembelian Pro dikongsi antara iPhone dan Mac?
faq.a: Ya. SmartDecrypt Pro ialah pembelian universal sekali. Beli sekali pada iOS atau macOS dan buka kunci Pro pada kedua-dua platform menggunakan ID Apple yang sama.

seo.desc: ContentCue ialah aplikasi baca-dan-dengar serba lengkap untuk iPhone, iPad dan Apple Vision Pro: pelayar bacaan dengan pemulihan kedudukan, pembaca RSS dengan taklimat audio, pemain podcast dengan muat turun luar talian, teks-ke-pertuturan laman web, CarPlay dan penyegerakan iCloud.

hero.title: Layari, baca dan dengar — dan jangan sesekali hilang tempat anda.
hero.desc: ContentCue ialah aplikasi serba lengkap: layari dengan pemulihan kedudukan automatik, dengar suapan RSS sebagai taklimat audio, strim atau muat turun podcast, dan minta mana-mana halaman web dibacakan — di iPhone, iPad, Apple Vision Pro dan CarPlay. Satu pembelian, semua peranti, disegerakkan dengan iCloud.
hero.trust1: RSS, podcast & web dalam satu app

how.title: Tiga langkah. Tiada persediaan diperlukan.
how.step1desc: Buka mana-mana laman web dalam ContentCue dan baca seperti biasa. Tiada persediaan setiap laman. Tiada akaun.
how.step2desc: Popup atau pengalihan membawa anda pergi. ContentCue secara automatik menyimpan kedudukan skrol tepat anda sebelum ia berlaku.
how.step3desc: Butang Teruskan muncul. Satu ketikan membawa anda kembali ke garis tepat yang anda sedang baca.

restore.title: Satu ketikan. Kembali ke tempat anda yang tepat.
restore.desc: ContentCue memantau gangguan halaman — popup, banner pengalihan, ketikan tidak sengaja pada iklan — dan secara automatik menyimpan kedudukan skrol anda. Butang Teruskan muncul apabila kedudukan anda disimpan. Ketiknya sekali dan anda kembali ke tempat anda berada.
restore.bullet1: Simpan kedudukan automatik pada setiap navigasi pergi
restore.bullet2: Butang Teruskan boleh dilihat pada bila-bila masa kedudukan anda disimpan
restore.bullet3: Berfungsi di semua laman kandungan — tiada konfigurasi setiap laman diperlukan

visual.title: Lihat apa itu kandungan dan apa itu iklan
visual.desc: ContentCue melukis sempadan berwarna di sekitar iklan dalam halaman supaya anda dapat membezakan mereka daripada kandungan yang anda sedang baca. Ini bukan penyekatan iklan — semua iklan masih memuatkan dan memaparkan dengan normal. Ia hanya kejelasan visual.

visual.bullet2: Semua iklan masih memuatkan dan memaparkan dengan normal

Tambah sehingga 3 halaman percuma ke penanda, atau naik taraf kepada Premium untuk penanda tanpa had, warna sempadan iklan tersuai, dan kelajuan skrol automatik boleh laras untuk webtoon, manga dan artikel panjang.
extras.bullet1: Peredaman audio — senyapkan semua audio laman web dengan satu ketikan
extras.bullet2: Penanda — 3 percuma, tanpa had dengan Premium
extras.bullet3: Kelajuan skrol automatik boleh laras untuk kandungan panjang (Premium)

pricing.title: Percuma setiap hari. Premium menghapuskan had.
pricing.feat8: Warna iklan tersuai, skrol automatik & Pintasan Siri
pricing.note: Premium tersedia sebagai langganan tahunan dengan percubaan percuma 7 hari, atau sebagai pembelian seumur hidup sekali sahaja. Harga dipaparkan dalam apl mengikut kawasan anda.

faq.q: Adakah ContentCue penyekat iklan?
faq.a: Tidak. ContentCue tidak menyekat, menyembunyikan, atau menghalang iklan daripada memuatkan. Semua iklan dipaparkan dengan normal. ContentCue meningkatkan navigasi dengan menyimpan kedudukan skrol anda apabila iklan mengganggu bacaan anda, dan ia melukis sempadan berwarna di sekitar iklan dalam halaman supaya anda dapat melihatnya dengan jelas.

faq.q: Laman web mana yang ContentCue berfungsi dengan?
faq.a: ContentCue ialah pelayar web penuh, jadi ia berfungsi dengan mana-mana laman web — Webtoons, Tapas, LINE Webtoon, halaman pencipta bebas, pengagregat manga, blog WordPress, dan ribuan lagi. Tiada persediaan setiap laman diperlukan.

faq.q: Bagaimana cara kerja pemulihan kedudukan?
faq.a: ContentCue memantau kedudukan skrol anda semasa anda membaca. Apabila anda menavigasi pergi (mengetik pautan iklan, pengalihan, atau butang kembali), ia menyimpan kedudukan tepat anda. Butang Teruskan muncul dalam UI pelayar. Ketiknya untuk kembali ke tempat anda berada.

faq.q: Adakah ContentCue mempunyai pembaca RSS?
faq.a: Ya. Langgan mana-mana suapan RSS, semat saluran kegemaran anda, dan import atau eksport keseluruhan senarai langganan anda melalui OPML. Aktifkan TTS untuk mendengar tajuk belum dibaca dibacakan sebagai taklimat audio berterusan, seperti radio peribadi.

faq.q: Bolehkah saya mendengar podcast dalam ContentCue?
faq.a: Ya. Cari dalam direktori podcast terbina dalam, semat rancangan yang anda ikuti, dan strim atau muat turun episod untuk didengar di luar talian. Main balik berfungsi dari skrin kunci dan disertakan pemasa tidur terbina dalam.

faq.q: Adakah ContentCue membaca laman web dengan kuat?
faq.a: Ya. Tekan main pada mana-mana artikel dan ContentCue membacanya dengan kuat menggunakan teks-ke-suara. Audio terus dimainkan di latar belakang walaupun skrin dikunci, dan apl cepat menyambung semula artikel serta kedudukan terakhir anda.

faq.q: Adakah ContentCue disegerakkan antara iPhone, iPad dan Vision Pro saya?
faq.a: Ya, dengan Premium. Penanda buku, suapan RSS dan langganan podcast disegerakkan secara automatik melalui iCloud merentas semua peranti Apple anda, termasuk Apple Vision Pro.

faq.q: Adakah ContentCue berfungsi di Apple Vision Pro?
faq.a: Ya. ContentCue mempunyai aplikasi visionOS natif — layari dalam tetingkap terapung, selak artikel dengan picitan pantas, dan kecilkan main balik kepada pemain sudut padat. Ia pembelian universal: beli sekali dan guna di iPhone, iPad dan Vision Pro, dengan Premium dikongsi merentas ketiga-tiganya.

faq.q: Adakah ContentCue menyokong CarPlay?
faq.a: Ya. ContentCue muncul pada paparan CarPlay kereta anda dengan podcast dan suapan RSS yang disimpan. Anda boleh memulakan main balik, melihat baris gilir semasa dan menukar kelajuan main balik terus dari skrin kereta.

faq.q: Adakah ContentCue mengumpul data pelayaran saya?
faq.a: Tidak. ContentCue memproses pelayaran sepenuhnya di peranti anda menggunakan WebKit Apple. Tiada sejarah pelayaran, URL yang dilawati, atau data peribadi dikumpul atau dihantar ke mana-mana.

faq.q: Apakah yang disertakan dalam ContentCue Premium?
faq.a: Versi percuma merangkumi pelayar bacaan penuh serta sehingga 3 penanda buku, 3 suapan RSS dan 3 rancangan podcast yang disimpan. Premium menghapuskan had tersebut — penanda buku, suapan dan rancangan tanpa had — dan menambah Penyegerakan iCloud merentas peranti, Pintasan Siri, warna garis luar iklan tersuai dan kelajuan skrol auto boleh laras. Tersedia sebagai langganan tahunan dengan percubaan percuma 7 hari, atau pembelian sekali seumur hidup.

cbz-reducer.cardDesc: Shrink comic archives by re-encoding the pages inside, without splitting the volume.
cbz-reducer.seoTitle: Reduce CBZ File Size — Free, In Your Browser, No Upload
cbz-reducer.seoDesc: Compress CBZ and ZIP comic archives in your browser. Re-encodes the pages inside at a resolution and quality you choose. Nothing is uploaded — the whole job runs on your device.
cbz-reducer.intro: Drop in a CBZ or ZIP and it re-encodes every page inside at the size and quality you pick, then hands the archive back. Large scans usually lose most of their weight with no visible difference on a phone screen.

sections.title: Why comic archives get so big
sections.body: A CBZ is just a ZIP full of page images. Scans are often stored at print resolution — 3000px wide or more — which is far beyond what any phone or tablet can display. Re-encoding those pages to the resolution you actually read at is usually where the savings come from, not the archive format.

sections.title: What the settings do
sections.body: Shortest-dimension resolution caps the smaller side of each page, so tall pages and spreads scale consistently. Quality controls the encoder. Grayscale drops colour channels entirely, which helps a lot on black-and-white manga and nothing at all on colour comics.

sections.title: Nothing leaves your device
sections.body: The archive is opened, re-encoded and rebuilt inside your browser using WebAssembly. There is no upload step, no queue and no server that ever sees the file — which also means it works on files you would not want to hand to a web service.

faq.q: Will this ruin the image quality?
faq.a: Only if you tell it to. The default settings target the resolution a phone or tablet actually renders at, which is well below what most scans are stored at, so the visible result is usually identical. If you archive at print quality, raise the resolution cap or leave the file alone.

faq.q: Does it work on CBR or RAR files?
faq.a: No — CBR is a RAR archive, and RAR cannot be opened in the browser for licensing reasons. Convert to CBZ first, or use the BiblioFuse app, which reads CBR directly.

faq.q: Is there a file size limit?
faq.a: The limit is your device's memory, not a server quota, because the work happens locally. Very large volumes are fine on a desktop; a phone with several hundred megabytes of pages may run out of room.

epub-reducer.cardDesc: Re-encode the images inside an EPUB so it syncs and stores smaller.
epub-reducer.seoTitle: Compress EPUB Files — Free, In Your Browser, No Upload
epub-reducer.seoDesc: Shrink EPUB files by re-encoding the images inside them, in your browser. Text and structure are left untouched. No upload, no account, nothing sent to a server.
epub-reducer.intro: Drop in an EPUB and it re-encodes the images inside — covers, illustrations, embedded scans — while leaving the text, structure and metadata exactly as they were.

sections.title: It is almost always the images
sections.body: The text in a novel-length EPUB is tiny — often under a megabyte. When an EPUB is large, it is because of embedded images stored at far higher resolution than any reader will display. Re-encoding those is where the size goes.

sections.title: What is left alone
sections.body: Chapter structure, table of contents, metadata and the text itself are untouched — they are copied through unchanged. Only the image files inside the archive are re-encoded, so the book opens and navigates exactly as before.

sections.title: Nothing leaves your device
sections.body: The EPUB is unpacked, processed and repacked inside your browser. No copy is uploaded, which matters for books you own but would rather not hand to a web service.

faq.q: Will it break DRM-protected books?
faq.a: It cannot open them at all. DRM-protected EPUBs are encrypted, so there is nothing to re-encode. This works on DRM-free files only.

faq.q: Does the text get compressed too?
faq.a: No. Text is copied through untouched — it is a negligible share of the file size and re-encoding it would risk breaking the book's structure for no gain.

faq.q: Will my reader still open it?
faq.a: Yes. The output is a standard EPUB with the same structure and metadata as the input; only the image files inside are smaller.

pdf-to-cbz.cardDesc: Turn a PDF comic into a CBZ so comic readers can page through it properly.
pdf-to-cbz.seoTitle: Convert PDF to CBZ — Free, In Your Browser, No Upload
pdf-to-cbz.seoDesc: Convert PDF comics and scans to CBZ in your browser. Each page is rendered to an image and packed into a comic archive. No upload, no account, nothing sent to a server.
pdf-to-cbz.intro: Drop in a PDF and every page is rendered to an image and packed into a CBZ, so comic readers can treat it as a proper page-by-page volume instead of a document.

sections.title: Why convert at all
sections.body: PDF is a document format. Comic readers built around CBZ get page-spread detection, reading direction, thumbnail grids and per-page bookmarks — features a PDF viewer generally does not offer for scanned comics.

sections.title: What you get out
sections.body: A standard CBZ: a ZIP of sequentially numbered page images. Pages are rendered at 2× scale so text and line art stay sharp when you zoom, then encoded to a web-friendly format.

sections.title: Nothing leaves your device
sections.body: Rendering and packing both happen in your browser. The PDF is never uploaded, so this is safe to use on scans and documents you would not want to put through a web service.

faq.q: Does the text stay searchable?
faq.a: No. CBZ is an image format by definition, so any selectable text in the PDF becomes part of the page image. If you need text search, keep the PDF — or read it in BiblioFuse, which can OCR pages on device.

faq.q: What resolution are the pages rendered at?
faq.a: 2× the PDF's native page size, which keeps line art and lettering sharp when zoomed. Larger PDFs therefore take longer and use more memory.

faq.q: Can it convert back the other way?
faq.a: Not here — this direction covers the common case of a PDF that ought to be a comic. The BiblioFuse app handles CBZ to PDF on device.

pdf-to-jpg.cardDesc: Export every page of a PDF as an image, downloaded as a ZIP.
pdf-to-jpg.seoTitle: Convert PDF to JPG — Free, In Your Browser, No Upload
pdf-to-jpg.seoDesc: Export PDF pages as JPG images in your browser and download them as a ZIP. Pick the render quality. No upload, no account, nothing sent to a server.
pdf-to-jpg.intro: Drop in a PDF and every page is rendered to a JPG at the quality you choose, then bundled into a single ZIP download.

sections.title: What it is for
sections.body: Pulling pages out as images — for a slide, a reference sheet, an issue report, or any workflow that wants pictures rather than a document. Every page is exported; there is no per-page selection step.

sections.title: Choosing quality
sections.body: The quality control is the render scale, not just the encoder setting. Higher values render each page larger before encoding, which keeps small text legible at the cost of file size and processing time.

sections.title: Nothing leaves your device
sections.body: Rendering uses the PDF engine built into the page and runs entirely in your browser. The file is never uploaded — which is the point if the PDF is a statement, a contract, or anything else you would not paste into a web tool.

faq.q: Can I export just one page?
faq.a: Not currently — every page is exported and delivered as a ZIP. Extract the one you need from the archive.

faq.q: Why JPG and not PNG?
faq.a: JPG is dramatically smaller for scanned and photographic pages, which is the common case. For line art or screenshots where you want lossless output, PDF to CBZ preserves more detail.

faq.q: Does it work on password-protected PDFs?
faq.a: No. An encrypted PDF has to be unlocked before anything can render it. SmartDecrypt, a separate app from the same studio, handles that case.

qr-generator.cardDesc: Make a setup QR code so the app can connect to your server without typing.
qr-generator.seoTitle: Kavita & Komga Setup QR Code Generator
qr-generator.seoDesc: Generate a QR code that points BiblioFuse at your Kavita or Komga server, so you do not have to type a URL and API key on a phone. Built in your browser; nothing is sent anywhere.
qr-generator.intro: Fill in your server details and get a QR code the app can scan — no typing a long URL and API key on a phone keyboard.

sections.title: Why a QR code
sections.body: A self-hosted server address plus an API key is a long, error-prone thing to type on a phone. Scanning a code gets both across in one step, correctly, every time.

sections.title: Your key never leaves the page
sections.body: The code is drawn in your browser from the values you type. Nothing is submitted, logged or stored — close the tab and it is gone. The generated image is only as private as wherever you choose to put it, so treat a printed code like the API key it contains.

faq.q: Is my API key sent anywhere?
faq.a: No. The QR code is generated locally in the page and the values you type are never transmitted or saved. Do bear in mind the finished code contains your key, so anyone who can photograph it can use it.

faq.q: Which servers does this support?
faq.a: Kavita and Komga. Pick the service type and the default port fills in; adjust the address if your setup differs.

items.q: How does streaming from Mac or PC to iPhone work?
items.a: Your Mac or PC runs a local server and writes the connection address to iCloud Drive. Your iPhone picks it up automatically. Both devices must have Tailscale on (works at home and remotely). If only one device has Tailscale on, the connection will fail. Keeping both devices always on Tailscale gives the most consistent experience.

items.q: Streaming is set up correctly but still not working — what should I try?
items.a: A stale endpoint cache is the most common cause. One or more stream_endpoint.json files stored in iCloud has an outdated timestamp, which prevents BiblioFuse from discovering the host.

items.q: Why can't Android receive books from Mac or PC?
items.a: The Android app uses a different codebase without iCloud integration, which is how the streaming handshake works. The best workflow for Android is to sync files to your phone using Syncthing or a similar tool, then add that folder as a library source in the app.

items.q: Does BiblioFuse work on Apple Vision Pro?
items.a: Yes. BiblioFuse is a native visionOS app on the App Store — a true spatial window, not a compatibility-mode iPad app. It supports eye tracking, pinch, mouse, trackpad, and keyboard, and it is included in the universal iOS + Mac purchase at no extra cost.

items.q: What spatial reading layouts does BiblioFuse support on visionOS?
items.a: Three spatial library layouts: Spatial Bookshelves (your covers on floating shelves), Grid View (a floating grid for large libraries), and Slanted Wall (an angled gallery wall with rating and tag filters). You can also stream your library from a Mac or PC to keep Vision Pro storage free.

items.q: How do I get better text-to-speech voices in BiblioFuse?
items.a: Higher-quality voices may already be available through your device's text-to-speech system, but some must be downloaded separately. BiblioFuse will detect newly installed voices automatically when they are made available to apps.
